title: Strawberry Chew E-liquid by The Finest – (2 pack
description:
Indulge in fresh strawberries’ deliciously sweet and tangy taste with The Finest’s Strawberry Chew E-liquid. This premium e-liquid is expertly crafted using high-quality ingredients to provide a smooth and satisfying vaping experience. With a 2-pack of 60ml bottles, you can enjoy the irresistible flavor of Strawberry Chew for longer. Available now at VaporFi!
Specs & Features:
30% PG / 70% VG
Flavor Profile: Strawberry, Chewy Candy
